known_pitfall_claim: In the Property 3 calculation, the proof asserts that ⟨g₁+g₂,h⟩ equals ⟨g₁,h⟩+⟨g₁,h⟩, duplicating the g₁ summand in place of the g₂ summand.
pitfall_counterexample: Use the singleton-index Hilbert direct sum with sole component ℝ. Let g₁(*)=0, g₂(*)=1, and h(*)=1. All are valid elements. Then g₁+g₂ has coordinate 1, so ⟨g₁+g₂,h⟩=1·1=1, whereas ⟨g₁,h⟩+⟨g₁,h⟩=0·1+0·1=0.
